workflows.label: Set scenario
workflows.note: The planning app's Downside / Base / Upside switch is a workbook control the forecast formulas read (set-scenario sets it; Snapshot records its value). Without the planning app, the one-row Parameters input table holds Selected Scenario instead.

workflows.label: Roll forward one month
workflows.note: Advances Parameters.Forecast Start Month by one month (update-rows, DateAdd). Replaces the VBA that copied the first forecast month into the Actuals table.

workflows.label: Snapshot version
workflows.note: Appends a Versions row (version label, time, scenario, forecast start month, user). The VBA also pasted the forecast grid as static values; the row logs the parameters in force instead, and the live Forecast stays reproducible from them.

workflows.label: Submit for approval
workflows.note: Appends an Approvals row (status Submitted, user, time). The VBA also protected the sheet and sent an Outlook email; neither is reproduced.

dispositions.note: The macro's external data reload is replaced by the source Tables landed in Snowflake (Phase 1b), which Sigma reads live; no refresh button is needed.
The email the macro sent is replaced by the Approvals row and the latest-status header; no email is sent by the workflow, the button or the agent.
Sigma recalculates on read; there is nothing to port.
Cell formatting is carried by workbook styling and number formats, not an action.
